svg.title: Sallora data model: 23 tables and how they link

text.font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 23 tables in 5 groups · PK primary key · FK link column · each line runs from a link column (●) to the table it points to (▶); lighter lines go to venues · drawn from backend/src/db/schema.ts by npm run db:diagram
